turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail:
A damaged item isn’t handled as a normal return. The warranty process does not require a separate return fee or ask you to mail the item back before review. It starts with a clear photo or video, your order number, and a description of the issue through the warranty claim form.

If the claim is approved, the resolution may be a replacement or store credit. Original shipping fees are not included in the warranty compensation.

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
Once your warranty claim is approved and the replacement is created, it ships by standard shipping only. Most orders ship within 1-2 business days, and standard delivery typically takes 3-7 business days within the US and Canada.

Expedited and overnight shipping aren’t available for replacement orders. The replacement must also be the exact same item and size, subject to availability.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is affected, include each damaged item in the same warranty claim. Please provide the name of every affected item, a clear photo or video of each one, and a description of each issue. The items must match products in your order, and the claim is subject to review and approval.
